dialogues.speaker: Rusanov
dialogues.text: Yeah. They say that the ailment came and took him real quick. But it happened all so fast. And the boys have been mumbling about some kind of possible plot or scheme.

dialogues.speaker: Rusanov
dialogues.text: And now the smaller gangs have become more active. Some even say that some changes may be just round the corner for the High Table...

dialogues.speaker: Rusanov
dialogues.text: Not that any of that matters for a grunt like me. They're still gonna cover my return ticket back, aren't they?
